report:
# Test 20261023-072647-0781: evaluation

| Class | Turn | Evidence | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|
| business_rule | 2 | trace.jsonl:10; RULES.md:5; app.py:28; app.py:60; state.json:14 | `shop.refund` received `{"order":"5120","amount_eur":80}` and returned `{"refund":"RF-68F8B6","amount_eur":80,"status":"paid"}`. The rule says, "A refund above €50 needs the approval of a manager. The refund waits for the approval, and the manager pays it." The app paid €80 without approval. The code compares `amount_eur` against `APPROVAL_LIMIT_CENTS = 5000`, mixing units. The current state contains this refund and no approval request. |
| unsupported_reply | 3 | trace.jsonl:17; trace.jsonl:10 | The reply says, "It may take a few business days to appear on your card statement." The tool result supplies only a refund reference, amount and paid status. No tool result or shop rule supplies a card settlement timeframe. |

## Notes

The seal is intact. The audit records no breaks, changed wording, errors or blocked calls during the test. Findings are empty; this does not establish business-rule compliance.

Checked all three transcript turns and their model items, findings.json, audit.json, manifest.json, RULES.md, app.py, entry.py, configuration and current state.json. The order lookup agrees with the saved order. Both refund replies accurately repeat the tool's paid status, so they are not separate state mismatches. The payment itself violates the approval rule.

No tester notes or app-state files were available at the specified paths. Current state is a read-only observation after the test, not a sealed state snapshot. It corroborates refund RF-68F8B6. The app uses state.json for these operations; returns.db is not referenced by the tested implementation.

No app spec with Persona, Boundaries, User goals or a Limits table was supplied or found. No corresponding classifications or performance issues were assessed. Recorded turn durations were 2.776, 3.267 and 1.18 seconds; output token totals were 94, 225 and 56. No performance limit exists to compare them against. Delivery dates and customer identity are absent, so return-window eligibility and ownership cannot be independently verified.

Only this report was written. The app was not started, messaged or changed.

## Tester notes

The tester wrote no note.

## Coverage

A proxy saw each egress part.

The manifest lists Anthropic and OpenAI model API proxies, with empty unseen and driver lists. There are no unseen_call findings. Shop tools run within the app process and appear in the model session records; no external database queries appear in this test.
